params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch correctly addresses the SonarQube warning by replacing a custom HostnameVerifier that always returns true (which disables hostname verification and is insecure) with the default hostname verifier provided by the TLS/SSL library. This fix directly targets the security issue without introducing unrelated changes or modifying other parts of the code unnecessarily. The change is minimal and focused solely on fixing the warning.

Score: 3
